pretreatment: OTS molecules were transferred onto both surfaces of either an AAO or a PC membrane by a standard mCP procedure. For AAO membranes, excess OTS molecules physisorbed on the surfaces of the membrane template were removed by immersing them in chloroform, therefore exposing inert methyl surfaces of OTS–SAMs on both surfaces of the template.
